title: orchis coriophora subsp. sancta
intro: Orchis coriophora subsp. sancta, commonly known as the Pyrenean bee orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to the Pyrenees mountain range. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Orchis coriophora subsp. sancta include its ability to treat kidney stones, improve prostate health, and act as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of this plant include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, attributed to bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins.
